metadata.scope: Development-only, never sufficient for research eligibility or open-domain L1 fluency
metadata.a_policy: A0 original four arrangements; A1 exactly three unique fit-only distractors with rotating category omission and deterministic fit-only fallback
metadata.a_position_rule: Omitted category=(exposure//4)%4; correct position=exposure%4; orthogonal over each sixteen exposures

b_policy_selection.requires: All twelve language-by-seed pairs complete; initial weights, meaning and comprehension-caption streams match; final producers match
b_policy_selection.score: Equal-weight macro over four binary diagnostic categories; mean four languages inside each seed block, then mean three seed blocks
b_policy_selection.choose_attributes_if: Grand paired delta >0, at least two of three seed-block deltas >0, and every language mean original four-choice delta >=-0.05
b_policy_selection.incomplete: selection undetermined; B may run predeclared same_pair fallback with explicit non-selection label

b_prior.images: Exactly the forty fit PNGs; no dev/protected images, captions, Scene labels, or fitted cross-split normalization
b_prior.conditions: Same spatial CNN random frozen vs image-reconstruction-pretrained frozen, same language initialization and L1 stream

metadata.candidate_rule: Both original scores >=0.9 and every binary category >=0.9 with at least eight distinct anchors and two object pairs; otherwise fail or indeterminate for insufficient coverage
metadata.known_coverage_limit: Current balanced dev has only four binding anchors from one object pair. A/B binding qualification is structurally indeterminate; do not lower the rule
metadata.conditional_stage_c: Separate five-color development world may be prepared because all fourteen current balanced splits have binding coverage <=4. Preserve all old protected pairs and the old fit/dev boundary; freeze new data before training and label changed population
metadata.resource_policy: Measure twenty disposable steps, reset before training; do not increase seeds or budgets based on scores; retain timeout/failed/cancelled runs
